title: Schooling at McDonogh 24
summary: No school music; he attended McDonogh No. 24 in Carrollton, possibly Mahalia Jackson's school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Yeah, pretty good. Did you play in any school bands then, or did they have any music in your school, if you remember?
No, no, we never had a piano, you know, their voices singing, you know.
What school did you go to?
Well, I went to McDonough No. 24.
Is it up there? Tom Lafon. Up in Carlton.
Well, yeah, McDonough 24 was in Carlton, and I mean, we had to walk around about 18 blocks of school, man. I mean, there wasn't no such a thing as school buses, you know.

I wonder if that's the school Mahalia Jackson went to. Same school. One of them up there. Same school. It's down near the river. Her church is on Milladon. That's right. And their school is only maybe near, yeah, right up in there. That's where. That's right. I've seen the school in a big white building. McDonough 24.
